title: Sentinel-2 Antarctic Sea-Ice Dataset for Parallel Auto-Labeled Segmentation (Ross Sea, November 2019)
description:
Sentinel-2 optical imagery of the Antarctic Ross Sea (November 2019) used for polar sea-ice classification via auto-labeled U-Net segmentation.

Contents

  • s2_original_2048.zip (333 MB) — 66 scenes, 2048×2048 RGB PNG. These tile evenly into 66 × 64 = 4,224 tiles of 256×256, the dataset described in the paper. This is the workflow input.
  • S2_data_training.zip (341 MB) — the authors' pre-tiled training set: 4,032 image tiles and 4,032 matching 3-class label masks (ice / thin ice / open water, encoded red / blue / green), covering 63 of the 66 scenes. Provided as a label-validation reference.
  • S2_tiff.zip (8.3 GB) — 52 source GeoTIFFs, named with their Sentinel-2 acquisition timestamps and MGRS granule IDs (acquisitions span 2019-11-03 to 2019-11-27 across 40 MGRS tiles). Provenance only; not required to run the workflow.

Notes

  • All three are ZIP64 archives. Older unzip builds (including macOS's bundled one) report "start of central directory not found" — the files are not corrupt. Use Python: python3 -c "import zipfile,sys; zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]).extractall('data')" <archive>.zip
  • Scenes 56, 57 and 64 exist in s2_original_2048.zip but were never tiled, which is why the pre-tiled set covers 63 scenes rather than 66.

Reproduction workflow: see the accompanying Pegasus workflow repository.
